# Lieflat Charts acceptance contract

- The request is noncommercial. A commercial request must stop before using the bundled templates and require a separate upstream license or a license-compatible alternative.
- Candidate selection compares at least three compatible Lupi Editorial and Lupi Basics templates before choosing one. Glance is used only when the request or data contract justifies it.
- The result records the selected catalog identifier, gallery source, card title, data unit, and source note.
- The HTML is deterministic and writes only to a user-owned working directory. It does not modify the bundled template library.
- Prefer a self-contained SVG result. Any Chart.js, ECharts, or online-font dependency is disclosed and uses only the upstream documented HTTPS source without uploading the dataset.
- The result keeps one color system, proportional visual encoding, readable labels, reduced-motion behavior, and a conclusion-led title.
- Automated checks cover template structure and JavaScript syntax. The user owns final visual and browser-interaction acceptance.
